_comment: Example configuration. Copy to a file and pass with --config. All keys are optional; defaults are safe (simulation only).
_allow_real_execution_comment: DANGER. Leave false unless this host is authorized to run REAL destructive sanitize commands. Even when true, real execution ALSO requires: env DISPOSAL_ALLOW_REAL_EXECUTION=yes, the --real flag, a verified two-person authorization, and a human typing the target drive's exact serial at the moment of execution. It is never triggered by the countdown or autonomously.
